description: Tier of a gate-local invocation (D-B5; gate_tier.derive, first match in the order battery, per_pr, batch, working_tree), exported by gate-hooks/tier.sh as OU_GATE_TIER. Neither --pr nor --sha: the working tree (gate-quiet), not a recorded proof. Values are the verdict contract's tiers: 1 per-PR, 2 batch, 3 battery.
